answer: Admission is priced by foresight, not presence. Each seat forecasts, across a short horizon, which of its randomly paired peers will fail the next audit, and standing accrues only to forecasts that beat the crowd average. A willow that echoes the crowd earns nothing, and clones fed by one information source emit identical forecasts, which the rule discounts by mutual agreement, so k copies collapse to the weight of one. Reaching k seats of standing takes k genuinely independent channels of judgment, and the jetty charges each seat a bond that doubles for every duplicate forecast it files.
